Description: Ability to wield plants.
Ability to wield air. This includes the ability to focus dragon fire into a stream using wind.
Riders: Cianna; Emery; Colonel Fremont; Captain Henson; Garrick Tavis

Description: Ability to send their consciousness out of their physical body. Their astral body is visible. They can also project multiple astral bodies and can manipulate the appearances of them.

Ability similar to precognition, limited to only being able to see the outcome of future battles. Due to a rune, General Melgren's signet is countered when three (3) or more people with rebellion relics are present in a battle.
Ability to counter and stop other riders' signets.
Ability to cross hundreds of miles in a single step.
Ability to access other's dreams and tamper with them. A form of inntinnsic ability.
Ability to change an object into stone.
Ability to see long distances with perfect clarity. Pupils dilate when signet is in use.
Ability to wield fire.
Riders: Aura Beinhaven; Avalynn; Professor Carr; Professor Grady; Mirabel; Timin Kagiso; Unnamed Rider Lieutenant

Description: Ability to wield ice.
Riders: Liam Mairi; Masen Sanborn; Ridoc Gamlyn

Description: Ability to project mental images as three-dimensional illusions for others to see.

Ability to read someone's surface level thoughts. Outlawed due to security risk, those that manifest this signet are executed. There are different types of inntinnsic abilities, as no two signets are exactly alike. In Xaden's case he's able to "see" a person's intentions as a series of mental pictures.

Ability to wield lightning, can create lightning regardless of current weather. The wielder acts as a conduit, creating lightning from the sky down, the ground up, or directly through the wielders hands. It's a form of pure power, or energy, that takes the shape of lightning.
Ability to erase or alter a persons recent memories. It is unknown how recent a memory has to be for it to be erased.

Exceptionally rare. Ability to fix, restore, or return anything to its original state, from ripped cloth to pulverized bridges including broken human bones. It is extremely painful, a white hot agony, only second to the pain of the original injury. Limitations: cannot mend missing limbs/appendages, and mending themselves is more difficult.
Riders: Brennan Sorrengail; Nolon Colbersy; Unnamed Navarrian Rider (Eastern Wing)

Description: Ability to wield metal.
Ability to summon an object within a short distance.
Ability to forsee the future, not just battle outcomes.
Ability to read someone's memories through touch. It's unknown how recent the memories have to be, for them to be read.
Ability to take away someone's ability to speak.

Incredibly rare and highly coveted battle signet. Ability to wield existing shadows. Can blackout large areas and manipulate objects within the shadows. Historically used to disorient entire drifts of gryphons or take them down, depending on the strength of the signet. Only controls shadows that already exist.
Ability to absorb power from various other sources including dragons and other riders, and then use it or redistribute it. The ability to imbue comes automatically to riders with this signet.
Ability to increase or decrease the size of an object.
Ability to hear sounds from across far distances (miles apart).
Ability to wield the weather.
Ability to detect whether or not someone is lying. Similar to inntinnsic's; however, they're allowed to live. Some truth-sayers can detect lies through bodily functions.
Ability to breathe underwater.
Ability to extend the natural wards that protect Navarre. They can also create wards around their person and their dragon.
Ability to unweave wards.
Ability to wield water.
Ability to look at someone and know their greatest weakness.
